* Added DispatchSchedule metadata on CodeTask, persisted via Firestore serializer, with user_scheduled and retry_cooloff sources (plus derivedBy, timezone, sourceText, derivedFromTaskId).

* pnpm run ci:tracked passed (typecheck, lint, 15993 tests, static validation, build, format) — PR #1939 opened against development.
